description_en: Enables or disables Simple Log Service for Web Application Firewall (WAF)
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-user-waf-log-status --instance-id waf-cn-mp91530000 --log-status 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyUserWafLogStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether Simple Log Service is enabled. Valid values:

0: Simple Log Service is disabled.

1: Simple Log Service is enabled
parameters.help_zh:
日志服务开启状态。取值：
0：表示关闭日志服务。
1：表示开启日志服务
parameters.name: log_status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the log storage region. If this parameter is not specified, Simple Log Service is enabled in the region where the WAF instance resides.

cn-hangzhou: the default region where Simple Log Service is enabled for a WAF instance in the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: the default region where Simple Log Service is enabled for a WAF instance outside the Chinese mainland.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712598.html to query the available log storage regions
parameters.help_zh:
日志存储地域ID。 如果未输入该参数，则会根据WAF实例所属地域开通日志服务。
cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地WAF实例开通日志服务默认所在地域。
ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地WAF实例开通日志服务默认所在地域。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712598.html接口查询用户可用的日志存储地域
parameters.name: log_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

LogStoreName.description_en: The name of the Logstore in Simple Log Service (SLS)
LogStoreName.description_zh: 日志服务SLS日志库LogStore的名称

ProjectName.description_en: Indicates whether the Simple Log Service project is created
